label: dormwarsfive4
title_zh: 地下城与女王！现充变御宅！

lines.en: label dormwarsfive4:
scene dungeondiva1
{b}{size=+15}AND ALSO RAID: SHADOW LEGENDS!{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: {b}{size=+15}还有《RAID：暗影传说》！{/size}{/b}

lines.en: scene dungeondiva2
Does this look like you? If the answer is yes, you’re probably human. And if you’re human, the chances are you’ll {b}LOVE{/b} RAID: Shadow Legends!
lines.zh: 这看起来像你吗？如果答案是「是」，那你可能就是人类。而如果你是人类，那你大概率会{b}爱上{/b}《RAID：暗影传说》！

lines.en: : But what if I {i}don’t{/i} love RAID: Shadow Legends?
lines.zh: : 可如果我就是{i}不{/i}爱《RAID：暗影传说》呢？

lines.en: {b}Great question!{/b}
lines.zh: {b}问得好！{/b}

lines.en: scene dungeondiva3
{b}{size=+10}WE’LL FUCKING KILL YOU.{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: {b}{size=+10}我们就他妈的杀了你。{/size}{/b}

lines.en: : Oh no. I have become the dead.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我成了死人。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva4
And you became that way thanks to Ginro the Stork — who is just one of over SEVEN MILLION champions in RAID: Shadow Legends!
lines.zh: 而让你变成这样的，正是 Ginro the Stork——它只是《RAID：暗影传说》中超过七百万名英雄中的一员！

lines.en: : I am Ginro the Stork, and I hate people who don’t play RAID: Shadow Legends.
lines.zh: : 我是 Ginro the Stork，我讨厌那些不玩《RAID：暗影传说》的人。

lines.en: {size=-5}Sign up now for ONE THOUSAND free pulls and the CONTACT INFORMATION of a LOCKSMITH who will change your locks to prevent our SHADOW ASSASSINS from sneaking into your house and ASSASSINATING your credit card!{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-5}现在注册，即可获得一千次免费抽卡，外加一位锁匠的联系方式，他会帮你换锁，防止我们的暗影刺客潜入你家、刺杀你的信用卡！{/size}

lines.en: : But what if I do not have a-
lines.zh: : 可如果我没有——

lines.en: : Ah. I am even more dead now.
lines.zh: : 啊。我现在死得更透了。

lines.en: : Silence, mortal. Feel the wrath of my PLUNGING BEAK and its 50%% chance to increase the cooldown of one of your skills by two turns.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，凡人。感受我俯冲之喙的怒火吧，它有 50%% 的概率让你某项技能的冷却时间延长两个回合。

lines.en: Ginro the Stork, what do you have to say to anyone who still isn’t playing RAID: Shadow Legends after this commercial ends?
lines.zh: Ginro the Stork，对于这条广告结束后仍然不玩《RAID：暗影传说》的人，你有什么要说的吗？

lines.en: : Nothing, for I will strike them down quicker than words could fall from my tongue.
lines.zh: : 无话可说，因为我会在言语从我舌头上坠落之前，先将他们击倒。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva5
RAID: Shadow Legends is- oh.
lines.zh: 《RAID：暗影传说》是——哦。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva6
RAID: Shadow Legends is COMPLETELY free to play! So free, in fact, that we’ll pay YOU to play it! Whatever you want! Just name your price!
lines.zh: 《RAID：暗影传说》完全免费游玩！免费到这种程度——我们付钱请你玩！你想要什么都行！开个价吧！

lines.en: THAT is how confident we are!
lines.zh: 这就是我们的自信！

lines.en: And as an additional show of that confidence, we’ve decided to teleport you all the way back to your childhood since we know you liked it so much!
lines.zh: 而作为这份自信的又一证明，我们决定把你一路传送回你的童年，因为我们知道你有多喜欢它！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva7
{b}ISN’T THAT AWESOME???{/b}
lines.zh: {b}这他妈是不是超棒？？？{/b}

lines.en: scene dungeondiva8
For the next nineteen seconds, signing up for RAID: Shadow Legends with the promo code GOODBOY will earn you ONE WHOLE GOD.
lines.zh: 在接下来的十九秒内，使用优惠码 GOODBOY 注册《RAID：暗影传说》，即可获得整整一位神。

lines.en: {size=-5}Wait LONGER than nineteen seconds and you’ll find that value multiplying and compounding every ADDITIONAL nineteen seconds until there are so many GODS that the universe will be forced to implode!{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-5}等待超过十九秒，你会发现那份价值每过额外的十九秒就会翻倍复利增长，直到神的数量多到宇宙被迫内爆！{/size}

lines.en: {b}ALSO IT WILL MAKE YOUR DICK BIGGER! IT WILL GIVE YOU MORE DICKS! {/b}
lines.zh: {b}而且它还会让你的鸡巴变大！会给你更多的鸡巴！{/b}

lines.en: scene dungeondiva9
You’ll have so many dicks that you won’t even know what to do with them! Then they’ll congeal into one MEGA-DICK and become your RIVAL!
lines.zh: 你会有多得不知道该怎么处理的鸡巴！然后它们会凝结成一根超级鸡巴，成为你的宿敌！

lines.en: It’ll fuck your girlfriend! Do you want a biblically accurate dick to FUCK YOUR GIRLFRIEND?!
lines.zh: 它会操你女朋友！你想要一根符合圣经描述的鸡巴去操你女朋友吗？！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva1
If the answer is no, then DOWNLOAD RAID: SHADOW LEGENDS to protect her!
lines.zh: 如果答案是不想，那就下载《RAID：暗影传说》来保护她！

lines.en: If the answer is yes, then we take it all back! And we will make the dick monster fuck your girlfriend IF you download RAID: SHADOW LEGENDS.
lines.zh: 如果答案是想，那我们把前面说的全部收回！而且只要你下载《RAID：暗影传说》，我们就会让那鸡巴怪物去操你女朋友。

lines.en: {b}{size=+10}THERE IS NO ESCAPE!{/size}{/b}
lines.zh: {b}{size=+10}无处可逃！{/size}{/b}

lines.en: {b}{size=+10}SUBMIT IF YOU WANT TO LIVE!{/size}{/b}
lines.zh: {b}{size=+10}想活命就屈服！{/size}{/b}

lines.en: scene dungeondiva10
: Hello and welcome back from that very brief word from our sponsor!
lines.zh: : 大家好，欢迎从那段非常短暂的赞助商广告回来！

lines.en: : I’m joined here today by Molly MacCormack! Who, after a very thorough check, I have confirmed is definitely a girl!
lines.zh: : 今天和我一起主持的是 Molly MacCormack！经过非常彻底的检查，我已经确认她绝对是个女生！

lines.en: : Druid first. Girl second.
lines.zh: : 首先是德鲁伊。其次才是女生。

lines.en: : And virgin third.
lines.zh: : 第三是处女。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva11
: Geh.
: Now, the point of this game is simple. I...think. But I don’t know anything about D&D. So why don’t you take it away and set the stage for us, Molly?
lines.zh: : 那么，这个游戏的要点很简单。我……觉得吧。不过我对龙与地下城一窍不通。不如你接过去，帮我们把舞台搭起来吧，Molly？

lines.en: scene dungeondiva12
: With pleasure! For setting the stage is the single most important responsibility of any dungeon master!
lines.zh: : 乐意至极！因为搭建舞台是任何一名地下城主最重要的职责！

lines.en: : And one must always be willing to craft an experience that is not just entirely welcoming to new players, but exciting and dramatic as well!
lines.zh: : 而且你必须时刻准备好，去打造一段经历——它不仅要对新手玩家完全友好，还要激动人心、充满戏剧性！

lines.en: : This {i}will,{/i} however, be the first time I have ever DMed for two people with zero interest in the game. So there is a chance this crashes and burns rather quickly.
lines.zh: : 不过，这{i}将{/i}是我第一次为两个对这游戏零兴趣的人担任城主。所以它有可能很快就玩砸。

lines.en: : On the bright side, I doubt it can go worse than the cooking competition.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，我怀疑它不至于比厨艺比赛更糟。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva13
: I regret nothing and feel as if I was able to get much closer to Yumi today.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不后悔，而且觉得今天和 Yumi 拉近了不少距离。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Then where is she?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？那她人在哪儿？

lines.en: : I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！

lines.en: : She ran away after I took my eye off of her. But I’ll get her back, I swear. It just...might take about eight years or so.
lines.zh: : 我一不留神她就跑掉了。但我会把她找回来的，我发誓。只是……可能要花上八年左右。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva14
: So, what are the rules of this again? Noriko gave me a brief rundown of how the game works last night, but I still don’t really get it.
lines.zh: : 那么，规则是什么来着？Noriko 昨晚给我粗略讲了这游戏怎么玩，但我还是不太懂。

lines.en: : {size=-3}I’ll set the stage in just a moment, but the main idea is that the character {i}you{/i} created will be fighting against the character {i}Chika{/i} created for a chance to marry the princess!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-3}我马上就搭舞台，不过主要思路是：你创建的角色将和 Chika 创建的角色战斗，争夺娶到公主的机会！{/size}

lines.en: : You mean like in Shrek?
lines.zh: : 你是说像《怪物史莱克》那样？

lines.en: scene dungeondiva15
: No! Not like Shrek!
lines.zh: : 不！不像《怪物史莱克》！

lines.en: : I mean, it’s a {i}little{/i} like Shrek. Like when Fiona was going to marry Lord Farquad and then Shrek and Donkey had to make it all the way to Duloc to stop the wedding.
lines.zh: : 我是说，是有{i}一点{/i}像《怪物史莱克》。就像 Fiona 要嫁给 Farquad 大人，然后史莱克和贫嘴驴得一路赶到 Duloc 去阻止那场婚礼。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva16
: That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : Wasn’t there also a scene like that in Wayne’s World 2 where Wayne has to stop Cassandra from getting married?
lines.zh: : 《反斗智多星 2》里不是也有类似的场景吗，Wayne 得阻止 Cassandra 结婚？

lines.en: : What a weird thing to keep typecasting Mike Myers for.
lines.zh: : 老是让 Mike Myers 演这种同一类型的角色，还真奇怪。

lines.en: : Guys, stop interrupting Molly. She was just about to get to the plot.
lines.zh: : 各位，别打断 Molly。她正要讲到剧情。

lines.en: : It’s the same thing, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是一样的对吧？

lines.en: scene dungeondiva17
: The...scene begins in...a cathedral...
lines.zh: : 场景……始于……一座大教堂……

lines.en: : Just before the princess is wed to Kirin’s character — Elenna Everbloom, a cynical and misunderstood warlock from deep within the forests of Sheenalion...
lines.zh: : 就在公主即将与 Kirin 的角色——Elenna Everbloom，一位来自 Sheenalion 森林深处、愤世嫉俗又被人误解的术士——成婚之际……

lines.en: : But...just before the wedding begins...Chika’s character and true love of the princess, Yahtel Vorrinn, storms the cathedral with her animal companion and...
lines.zh: : 但……就在婚礼即将开始之前……Chika 的角色、也是公主的真心爱人 Yahtel Vorrinn，带着她的动物伙伴冲进大教堂……

lines.en: : And challenges Elenna to a battle to the death.
lines.zh: : 然后向 Elenna 发起一场至死方休的决斗。

lines.en: : Isn’t Chika’s character a dragon lady?
lines.zh: : Chika 的角色不是个龙女吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. With a mule as a combat pet thingy. Who I {i}did{/i} name Theodore originally, but I’m just going to call him Donkey now.
lines.zh: : 嗯。带着一头骡子当战斗宠物什么的。我{i}本来{/i}给它起名叫 Theodore，不过我现在就叫它贫嘴驴了。

lines.en: : So Chika’s Shrek and I’m Lord Farquad. Got it.
lines.zh: : 所以 Chika 是史莱克，我是 Farquad 大人。懂了。

lines.en: : Did you plagiarize Shrek thinking you could get it by us, Molly?
lines.zh: : 你是抄袭了《怪物史莱克》，觉得能瞒过我们吧，Molly？

lines.en: scene dungeondiva18
: You did, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你就是抄了对吧？

lines.en: : I have been struggling creatively as of late. And I had less than twenty-four hours to come up with something, so...
lines.zh: : 我最近在创作上很挣扎。而且我只有不到二十四小时来想点子，所以……

lines.en: : Yes. Chika is Shrek and Kirin is Lord Farquad.
lines.zh: : 是的。Chika 是史莱克，Kirin 是 Farquad 大人。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva19
: Begin!
lines.zh: : 开始！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva20
: Wait, how? Do I just, like...say I attack her and you decide if I succeed?
lines.zh: : 等等，怎么开始？我就……比如说「我攻击她」，然后你判定我是否成功？

lines.en: : Assuming the two of you will be skipping any roleplay, both characters must first roll for initiative to determine who acts first.
lines.zh: : 假设你们俩要跳过所有角色扮演环节，那么两个角色必须先投先攻，决定谁先行动。

lines.en: : Okay. How do I do-
lines.zh: : 好。我要怎么——

lines.en: scene dungeondiva21
: That’s...sixteen.
lines.zh: : 那是……十六。

lines.en: : Hey, no fair. Kirin already knows how to play.
lines.zh: : 喂，不公平。Kirin 已经会玩了。

lines.en: : Like I said, Noriko showed me the ropes last night. Rolling dice isn’t exactly difficult and that’s all we’ve done so far.
lines.zh: : 我说了啊，Noriko 昨晚教了我基本操作。掷骰子又不是什么难事，而且我们目前也就做了这个。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva22
: Does it matter which one? There are so many different kinds.
lines.zh: : 哪个骰子有区别吗？种类太多了。

lines.en: : The one with the skull on it next to your water. That’s a D20.
lines.zh: : 你水杯旁边那个印着骷髅的。那是 D20。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva23
: This one?
lines.zh: : 这个？

lines.en: : Mhm. Pick that up and roll it.
lines.zh: : 嗯。拿起来掷。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva24
: Prepare to die, Lord Farquad.
lines.zh: : 受死吧，Farquad 大人。

lines.en: : {i}Elenna!{/i} Elenna Everbloom! At least get her name right!
lines.zh: : {i}Elenna{/i}！Elenna Everbloom！至少把她的名字叫对！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva25
: That’s a...5!
: Oh no. It’s already happening.
lines.zh: : 哦不。已经开始了。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva26
: Once Yahtel bursts her way into the cathedral, she’s surprised to find Elenna already lying in wait after receiving word from the royal scouts about an intruder approaching!
lines.zh: : Yahtel 冲进大教堂后，惊讶地发现 Elenna 早已埋伏在此——她从皇家斥候那里得到了有入侵者逼近的消息！

lines.en: : But what she’s even more surprised to find is her one true love, Princess Shadre of Sheurchester, cowering in the corner of the room as a curse overtakes her body!
lines.zh: : 但更让她惊讶的是，她的真爱、Sheurchester 的 Shadre 公主，正蜷缩在房间角落，身体被一道诅咒侵蚀！

lines.en: : Ngh! H...Help! I’m...turning into...an ogre!
lines.zh: : 嗯啊！救……救命！我在……变成……一头食人魔！

lines.en: : That is not what the curse is supposed to be! But I suppose it does not matter much in this moment! Just kill each other! Kirin goes first!
lines.zh: : 诅咒本来不是这个设定的！不过此刻想来也无所谓了！你俩只管互相砍杀吧！Kirin 先攻！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva27
: I attack Shrek with eldritch blast.
lines.zh: : 我用魔能爆攻击史莱克。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva28
: And it lands on a...seventeen.
lines.zh: : 然后命中值是……十七。

lines.en: : You’re normally supposed to roleplay your actions and stuff. The game isn’t really fun if you just name your attacks and move on.
lines.zh: : 你正常来说应该把你的行动演绎出来的。只是报个招式名就过，这游戏可不好玩。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva29
: But you specifically told me that playing this warlock class was as easy as just saying “eldritch blast” over and over.
lines.zh: : 可你明明跟我说，玩这个术士职业简单到只要一遍遍喊「魔能爆」就行了。

lines.en: : Hey! You have to do other stuff sometimes! I used mage hand once!
lines.zh: : 喂！你有时候还得做点别的！我就用过一次法师之手！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva30
: What does that do? Do I have that? Should I use that instead?
lines.zh: : 那是干什么的？我有那个吗？我该改用那个吗？

lines.en: : It just makes a magic hand that floats around and does regular hand stuff.
lines.zh: : 就是变出一只魔法手飘来飘去，做普通手能做的事。

lines.en: : Can you fuck it?
lines.zh: : 能上它吗？

lines.en: : Ew! Obviously not, Kirin!
lines.zh: : 呕！当然不能，Kirin！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva31
: I mean...you {i}could.{/i} You can kind of just...fuck {i}anything{/i} in D&D so long as the DM allows it.
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}可以{/i}。只要城主允许，你在龙与地下城里基本上{i}什么{/i}都能上。

lines.en: : It just makes people uncomfortable a lot of the time and you probably {i}shouldn’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : 只是那经常会让别人不舒服，你大概率{i}不该{/i}这么做。

lines.en: : {size=-2}I take back everything I said about how this game is for virgins, Molly. It’s totally cool and normal to sit at a table with your friends and pretend to have sex with ghost hands together.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我收回我说过的关于这游戏是给处女玩的话，Molly。和朋友们围坐在桌前，假装集体和幽灵手做爱，这完全又酷又正常。{/size}

lines.en: scene dungeondiva32
: There’s obviously more to it than that! Kirin, your eldritch blast connects with Yahtel! Roll for damage! And include at least some form of narration about it!
lines.zh: : 显然不止这些！Kirin，你的魔能爆命中了 Yahtel！掷伤害！而且至少要用某种叙述的方式表达出来！

lines.en: : Noriko, which dice do I-
lines.zh: : Noriko，我用哪个骰子——

lines.en: : These. Here. You have three beams, so you roll one d10 for each.
lines.zh: : 这几个。给。你有三道光束，所以每道掷一个 d10。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢了。

lines.en: : That’s...wow, really? All those dice and I only got 10 after adding everything up?
lines.zh: : 那是……哇，真的假的？掷了这么多骰子，全部加起来才 10？

lines.en: : Welcome to D&D. Now make it sound more fun than just blasting Chika and keeping your mouth shut.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到龙与地下城。现在把它说得比只是「轰了 Chika 一下然后闭嘴」更有趣些。

lines.en: : Uhh, okay. I...raise up my staff or whatever and-
lines.zh: : 呃，好。我……举起我的法杖还是什么，然后——

lines.en: : You don’t have a staff, Kirin. Look at your sheet. This part shows you where-
lines.zh: : 你没有法杖，Kirin。看你的角色卡。这部分告诉你——

lines.en: : I-I see it! I just don’t get how the fuck I cast the spell at all then!
lines.zh: : 我……我看到了！我只是不明白那我他妈到底要怎么施这个法术！

lines.en: : It comes out of your hand. Like this — PACHEW! Boom. Perfect eldritch blast noise.
lines.zh: : 从你手里发出来。像这样——啪啾！轰。完美的魔能爆音效。

lines.en: : Fucking...PACHEW! There. I hit Shrek.
lines.zh: : 他妈的……啪啾！好了。我打中史莱克了。

lines.en: : Ouch. My ogrish body has received your attack. Thankfully, I am covered in onion-like layers that protect me from receiving full damage.
lines.zh: : 哎哟。我这食人魔的身体承受了你的攻击。幸好我身上覆盖着洋葱般的层叠结构，能让我免于承受全额伤害。

lines.en: : No, you still receive the full 10 points of damage. But I {i}am{/i} grateful that you made more of an attempt to narrate than Kirin did.
lines.zh: : 不，你仍然承受完整的 10 点伤害。不过我{i}很感激{/i}你比 Kirin 更努力地去叙述了。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva33
: What the fuck do you want from me?! This is embarrassing enough as is!
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底想让我怎样？！这已经够丢人的了！

lines.en: : What do I do now, Rin? I don’t have that blast thing too, do I?
lines.zh: : 那我现在做什么，Rin？我没有那个爆的东西对吧？

lines.en: scene dungeondiva34
: Nope! You’re a ranger, so you’re going to want to attack Lord Farquad with your bow and your lovable donkey companion voiced by Eddie Murphy.
lines.zh: : 没有！你是游侠，所以你要用弓和你那只由 Eddie Murphy 配音的可爱驴子伙伴去攻击 Farquad 大人。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva35
: Use your action to attack with your bow first. Then, once that’s resolved, tell Molly you want to use your {i}bonus{/i} action to command your donkey to attack.
lines.zh: : 先用你的动作以弓攻击。等那个结算完，再告诉 Molly 你想用{i}附赠{/i}动作命令你的驴子攻击。

lines.en: : She’ll tell you what to roll and when. But chances are, since you’re sitting next to me and I am cursed, you’re only going to roll fives. I am so sorry.
lines.zh: : 她会告诉你要掷什么、什么时候掷。不过大概率，因为你坐在我旁边，而我又被诅咒了，你只会掷出五。我很抱歉。

lines.en: : You’re so cute.
lines.zh: : 你真可爱。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva36
: What? Huh?
lines.zh: : 什么？啊？

lines.en: : I just don’t see you get this excited about stuff often. And I think it’s really impressive how much you know about this game.
lines.zh: : 我只是很少看到你对什么事这么来劲。而且我觉得你知道这么多关于这游戏的东西，真的很厉害。

lines.en: : I actually kind of suck. Molly’s the impressive one out of everybody here. {i}She’s{/i} the one you want to be complimenting.
lines.zh: : 其实我挺烂的。这里所有人里厉害的是 Molly。你该夸的是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva37
: Nah. I think you’re cuter than her.
lines.zh: : 不。我觉得你比她可爱。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva38
: Kiss.
lines.zh: : 亲一个。

lines.en: : Um, hello? I am {i}right{/i} here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，打扰一下？我{i}就{/i}在这儿呢。

lines.en: : I want them to kiss.
lines.zh: : 我要她们亲。

lines.en: : I use my next turn to fuck my mage hand.
lines.zh: : 我用下一回合来上我的法师之手。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva39
: Yahtel hasn’t even rolled to hit yet! You must wait for her turn to resolve before fucking {i}anything!{/i}
lines.zh: : Yahtel 还没掷命中呢！你必须等她的回合结算完才能上{i}任何东西{/i}！

lines.en: : But let it also be known that using your turn in such a way puts you at an even greater disadvantage than you already are going up against two characters at once! Chika-
lines.zh: : 不过也请各位知悉，你以这种方式使用回合，会让你本就同时对抗两名角色的处境雪上加霜！Chika——

lines.en: : Five!
: Miss! Are you still using your bonus action on an attack for Donkey?! I MEAN...THEODORE!
lines.zh: : 未命中！你还要把附赠动作用于 Donkey 的攻击吗？！我是说……THEODORE！

lines.en: : I guess so! I’m not really sure what else to do, so I’m just listening to Rin.
lines.zh: : 大概吧！我也不太确定还能做什么，所以我只听 Rin 的。

lines.en: : Roll again!
lines.zh: : 再掷一次！

lines.en: : That’s...five? Wow, Rin. You really are cursed, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 那是……五？哇，Rin。你真的是被诅咒了啊？

lines.en: : How joyous it is to watch so many attractive women pretending to both be and slay hideous monsters.
lines.zh: : 看着这么多美女一边假装自己是、一边又去屠戮丑陋的怪物，真是令人愉悦。

lines.en: : They’re not {i}all{/i} monsters, Tsuneyo. I’m pretty sure Kirin’s playing an elf based on her name and origin.
lines.zh: : 她们不{i}全{/i}是怪物，Tsuneyo。我挺确定 Kirin 从名字和出身来看演的是个精灵。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva40
: Ahh, yes. I have heard that you are particularly attracted to that mythical race.
lines.zh: : 啊，是的。我听说你对那个神话种族格外着迷。

lines.en: : Is there something different about their genitals? Or do you simply enjoy the sounds of the forest?
lines.zh: : 是它们的生殖器有什么不同吗？还是说你单纯喜欢森林的声音？

lines.en: : You read one book with elf sex and suddenly everyone won’t stop talking about how it's your entire sexual personality. What is my life now?
lines.zh: : 你不过就是读了一本有精灵性爱的书，结果所有人就都开始没完没了地说那是你的全部性癖。我的人生现在是什么啊？

lines.en: : At least you do not have sexual intercourse with ghosts or continuously wake up without your clothes on. I believe that is my “sexual personality” now.
lines.zh: : 至少你没有和幽灵性交，也没有一觉醒来发现衣服不见了。我想那现在就是我的「性癖」了。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva41
: I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，什么？

lines.en: : I have also learned I am not very good at masturbating. I don’t think I fully understand it. But I am trying, and I believe that is what counts.
lines.zh: : 我还发现自己不太擅长自慰。我觉得我并没有完全理解它。但我在努力，而且我相信这才是重要的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，什么？

lines.en: scene dungeondiva42
: Forgive me. I neglected to take into consideration the fact that you may not yet understand what masturbation is. It was only a short while ago that I too-
lines.zh: : 请原谅。我忽略了你可能还不理解自慰是什么这一点。就在不久之前，我也同样——

lines.en: scene dungeondiva43
: Tsuneyo, I know what it is! But it’s not a thing you should just openly discuss with other people like that!
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，我知道那是什么！但那不是你可以就这样公开和别人讨论的事！

lines.en: : It’s not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : No! Which is why I’m so thrown off by how everyone around me keeps doing it all of a sudden! Like, who {i}cares{/i} if I don’t have any sex toys?! It doesn’t matter!
lines.zh: : 不是！所以我才被周围的人一个个突然都这么干搞得这么措手不及！比如，我没有性玩具有{i}什么关系{/i}吗？！那根本不重要！

lines.en: : There are {i}toys{/i} now? This is news to me.
lines.zh: : 现在有{i}玩具{/i}了？这我倒是第一次听说。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva44
: No. And don’t look them up either. I am a liar and I was lying to you.
lines.zh: : 没有。而且你也别去查。我是个骗子，我刚才在骗你。

lines.en: : I did not realize sex was so popular that it had been licensed for physical goods. It is no wonder so many of you have been fornicating with the teacher.
lines.zh: : 我没想到性已经流行到被授权生产实体商品了。难怪你们这么多人一直在和老师通奸。

lines.en: : No one is fornicating with the teacher, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 没有人在和老师通奸，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Not the female one. The male one who no longer comes here. Probably because he is too busy fornicating with women.
lines.zh: : 不是那个女的。是那个已经不来这儿的男的。大概是因为他忙着和女人通奸吧。

lines.en: : I repeat — {i}no one is fornicating with the teacher, Tsuneyo.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我再重复一遍——{i}没有人在和老师通奸，Tsuneyo。{/i}

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 我在。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva45
: You’re what?! Since when?!
lines.zh: : 你什么？！从什么时候开始的？！

lines.en: : Since before the golden noodle trap. Though it seems as if it is all just in my head. I believe there may be something wrong with my brain.
lines.zh: : 从金色面条陷阱之前就开始了。不过看起来那一切都只存在于我的脑子里。我觉得我的脑子可能是有点问题。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva46
: There’s nothing wrong with your brain, Tsuneyo...It’s normal for girls our age to start getting curious about stuff like that. It’s just...normally done in private.
lines.zh: : 你的脑子没问题，Tsuneyo……我们这个年纪的女孩开始对那类事感到好奇，是很正常的。只是……通常是私下里做的。

lines.en: : I do not understand why. Would it not make more sense for all of us to just fornicate with one another if doing so would positively impact our mental and physical health?
lines.zh: : 我不理解为什么。如果我们互相通奸能对身心健康产生积极影响，那不是更有道理吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure there are many girls in our class who would be very excited to hear you say that. But I am not one of them.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定班上有很多女生会很兴奋听到你这么说。但我不是其中之一。

lines.en: : A purebred man-fucker. Impressive.
lines.zh: : 一个纯种的男人迷。令人佩服。

lines.en: : Will you show me how?
lines.zh: : 你能教教我吗？

lines.en: scene dungeondiva47
: No! And I encourage you not to ask anyone else either since it can’t possibly lead to anything good!
lines.zh: : 不能！而且我劝你也别去问别人，因为那不可能引出什么好结果！

lines.en: : I see. I suppose that might explain why I keep blacking out and waking up without my clothes on then.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。那么这大概就能解释，为什么我总是昏过去、醒来时发现衣服不见了。

lines.en: scene black
: See a doctor about that! It’s not something I can help you with and...sounds extremely dangerous! And...also cold.
lines.zh: : 那去看医生！那不是我能帮上忙的事，而且……听起来非常危险！而且……也很冷。

lines.en: : I will ask the female teacher. She seems particularly fascinated with my body. Perhaps she knows how to fix it?
lines.zh: : 我会去问那位女老师。她似乎对我的身体格外着迷。也许她知道怎么修？

lines.en: : Definitely don't drag Miss Imai into this! I like her and I don’t want her getting in trouble!
lines.zh: : 千万别把 Imai 老师扯进来！我喜欢她，我不想她惹上麻烦！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva48
: That is...23 points of damage total. I think.
lines.zh: : 那是……总共 23 点伤害。我想。

lines.en: : What? Is that bad? Can I heal?
lines.zh: : 什么？那很糟吗？我能治疗吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s bad. You just died. Now Lord Farquad gets to marry Fiona and it’s going to throw the entire world into chaos. Probably.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很糟。你刚刚死了。现在 Farquad 大人可以娶 Fiona 了，整个世界大概要陷入混乱了。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva49
: Wait, I won?! Really?!
lines.zh: : 等等，我赢了？！真的吗？！

lines.en: : Thanks in no small part to Chika setting the record for most consecutive fives rolled in a row.
lines.zh: : 这要多亏 Chika 创下了连续掷出五的纪录。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva50
: {i}Second{/i} most consecutive fives rolled in a row. The true record belong to Nithhala with a grand total of 3,325.
lines.zh: : 是{i}第二{/i}多的纪录。真正的纪录属于 Nithhala，总计 3,325 次。

lines.en: : Hell yeah, Kirin! Great job making up for the point your roommate lost us when she chose friendship over family!
lines.zh: : 好耶，Kirin！干得漂亮，把你室友选友情弃家族丢掉的那分补回来了！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva51
: Good game, Kirin. It was nice being able to fight against you without either one of us calling the other a slut at all.
lines.zh: : 打得不错，Kirin。能和你对战，而双方一次都没骂对方骚货，感觉真好。

lines.en: : Sorry for being an omen of bad luck, Chika. This dark cloud follows me wherever I go and I will never escape its grasp.
lines.zh: : 抱歉当了个厄运的预兆，Chika。这片乌云跟着我走到哪儿，我永远也逃不出它的掌心。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva52
: Don’t apologize, Rin! I wouldn’t have been able to play at all without you. I had a lot of fun even {i}if{/i} I never managed to land a single hit. We should do it again sometime.
lines.zh: : 别道歉，Rin！没有你我根本玩不了。{i}就算{/i}一次都没命中，我也玩得很开心。我们改天应该再来一次。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva53
: What, like...D&D? You’d actually...want to play it again?
lines.zh: : 什么，比如……龙与地下城？你真的……还想再玩一次？

lines.en: : Why do you seem so shocked to hear that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么听起来这么震惊？

lines.en: : Because you’re cool and I’m a loser. And every second you spend with me is just slowly contaminating you.
lines.zh: : 因为你很酷而我是个废物。你和我待在一起的每一秒，都在被我慢慢污染。

lines.en: : If hanging out with you makes me a loser, so be it. {i}I{/i} think you’re pretty cool.
lines.zh: : 如果和你混在一起让{i}我{/i}变成废物，那就这样吧。我觉得你挺酷的。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva54
: Kiss!
lines.zh: : 亲一个！

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah! Praise me more! I did a good job! I’m the queen of the nerds! Move over, Molly! This is Farquad’s kingdom now!
lines.zh: :  blah blah blah！多夸夸我！我干得漂亮！我是宅女之王！让开，Molly！现在是 Farquad 的王国了！

lines.en: scene black
: For the love of Alduin, just use your character’s name! It exists for a reason!
lines.zh: : 看在 Alduin 的份上，用你角色的名字吧！它存在是有理由的！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva55
: Well Makoto — it’s only a matter of time now ‘til your girl goes up in flames. Hope ya enjoyed gettin’ to know me.
lines.zh: : 那么 Makoto——现在只是时间问题了，你家那位就要被烧成灰了。希望你喜欢认识我的这段时间。

lines.en: : You act like you’re competing against someone with an advantage. You’re up against Yasu, Miku. Her grades are only a little better than yours.
lines.zh: : 你搞得好像自己在跟一个有优势的人比赛似的。你的对手是 Yasu，Miku。她的成绩只比你好一点点。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva56
: That’s exactly the friggin’ problem, Makoto! This is {i}Yasu{/i} we’re talkin’ about! How is {i}she{/i} smarter than me?! She only knows about weird god stuff!
lines.zh: : 问题就他妈出在这儿，Makoto！我们说的是 {i}Yasu{/i} 啊！{i}她{/i}怎么可能比我聪明？！她只知道些奇怪的神明玩意儿！

lines.en: : What if we get friggin’ weird god questions?! What am I gonna do then, huh?
lines.zh: : 要是出了他妈的奇怪神明题怎么办？！那我要怎么办啊？

lines.en: : Lose. But that’s also what would happen if Yasu were to get sports questions — which are a thing we have literally gotten in other trivia contests before.
lines.zh: : 输。不过如果 Yasu 遇到体育题也是一样的下场——而我们以前的问答比赛里确实出过那种题。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva57
: Wait, yeah! If we get questions about that stuff, there ain’t no way Yasu could beat me!
lines.zh: : 等等，对啊！要是出那类题，Yasu 绝不可能赢我！

lines.en: : I’ve just gotta stand my ground and play defense! Throw her off her game and interrupt her when it’s {i}her{/i} turn to answer so she can’t ever get any words out!
lines.zh: : 我只要站稳脚跟打防守！干扰{i}她{/i}的节奏，轮到她回答的时候就打断她，让她一个字都说不出来！

lines.en: : I believe that is against the rules, but go for it if it’s what makes you happy. Just be prepared for Imani to-
lines.zh: : 我相信那是违反规则的，不过如果能让你开心就去做吧。只要做好 Imani 会——

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva58
: Yo, Sensei! Whaddya say you take me to your office and gimme a tour of your fingers one last time before I suffer a trivia-related death?
lines.zh: : 哟，Sensei！在我死于问答之前，带我去你办公室，让我最后再参观一次你的手指怎么样？

lines.en: : How did you even get in here? There’s no entrance that way.
lines.zh: : 你是怎么进来的？那边没有入口啊。

lines.en: : Ayane finally showed me her secret room. You wouldn’t believe what else is in there.
lines.zh: : Ayane 终于给我看了她的秘密房间。你不会相信里面还有什么。

lines.en: : I wager there are very few things I wouldn’t believe at this point.
lines.zh: : 我敢说，到了这个地步，我不信的事已经很少了。

lines.en: : I’ll say! If ya believe in me when it comes to winnin’ this next contest, can’t imagine there’s much out there at all you wouldn’t be able to hop on board with.
lines.zh: : 我说！如果你在下一场比赛上相信我能赢，那我想这世上根本没什么事是你接受不了的。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva59
: Oh, no. I don’t expect you to win at all. I think Yasu’s going to come out on top somehow.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。我压根没指望你能赢。我觉得 Yasu 总会以某种方式胜出。

lines.en: : Well then what the heck was all of that positive reinforcement for?!
lines.zh: : 那刚才那些正面鼓励到底是干嘛的？！

lines.en: scene dungeondiva60
: Reaffirming our friendship and reminding you that the gap in your respective intellects isn’t as big as you think! Go Miku! Woohoo!
lines.zh: : 重申我们的友谊，并提醒你，你们俩智力上的差距没有你以为的那么大！加油 Miku！哇哦！

lines.en: : Come on, Sensei. I don’t wanna die before gettin’ one last orgasm in.
lines.zh: : 拜托啦，Sensei。我可不想在死前连最后一次高潮都没体验到。

lines.en: : God, I really wish you never learned about sex.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我真希望你从没了解过性。

lines.en: scene dungeondiva61
: But I sometimes wish that {i}I{/i} had never learned about it either as it is pretty consistently the root of many of my problems!
lines.zh: : 但有时候{i}我{/i}也希望自己从没了解过它，因为它一贯是我诸多问题的根源！

lines.en: : Hey, same. But now that I know about it, I wouldn’t trade it for the world.
lines.zh: : 嘿，同感。不过既然我已经知道了，给我全世界我也不换。

lines.en: : Agreed. Which is why you should take me to your office instead of Miku. {i}I{/i} know what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 同意。所以你应该带我去你办公室，而不是 Miku。{i}我{/i}知道我在做什么。

lines.en: scene black
: Ay! That ain’t fair! You’ve had more time to learn! I’m still tryin’ to catch up! Come on, Sensei! We’re gettin’ outta-
lines.zh: : 喂！这不公平！你有更多时间去学！我还在努力追赶呢！走了，Sensei！我们要出——

lines.en: : Nope! You’re not going anywhere, Miku. Because you need to get to the library and put our floor back on top!
lines.zh: : 不行！你哪儿也去不了，Miku。因为你要去图书馆，把我们这层楼重新推回榜首！

lines.en: : But if the first floor is on top of the second floor, doesn’t {i}it{/i} become the second floor?! Meaning we can only win if we lose?!
lines.zh: : 可如果一楼在二楼上面，那{i}它{/i}不就变成二楼了吗？！意思是我们只有输了才能赢？！

lines.en: : That...uhh...she’s...she’s kinda {i}right,{/i} isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 那……呃……她……她说得好像有点{i}道理{/i}，不是吗？

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, that might actually be the smartest thing I’ve ever heard Miku say.
lines.zh: : 说来奇怪，那可能是我听过的 Miku 说过最聪明的一句话。

lines.en: : Well, it ain’t like there’s much competition!
lines.zh: : 那可没什么竞争对手嘛！
